plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Biology Major (BA) program page (poid=885). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the major requirement only; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Courses titled 'with Lab' carry separate lab corequisites in the catalog (BIOL 100L, BIOL 101L, BIOL 205L, BIOL 210L, BIOL 310L, CHEM 110L, CHEM 120L, CHEM 201L, CHEM 202L, PHYS 210L, PHYS 220L), each printed at 0 Hour(s); the 0-credit labs are disclosed here and are not placed as separate courses. Catalog anomaly, transcribed as printed and not corrected: CHEM 120's detail page prints its prerequisite as 'XXX 111', and CHEM 110L's detail prints 'Lab component of XXX 111'; no such course exists in the catalog, so CHEM 120 carries no recorded prerequisite. The catalog states the BA major is eleven courses, including eight biology courses, but prints no total semester-hour figure for the major; the recorded total (41) is the exact sum of the itemized requirements: fixed courses sum to 38 and the single Biology elective slot, printed at 3-5 Hours, is recorded at its 3-hour minimum (a completion using a higher-credit elective totals 42-43). The catalog lists the mathematics requirement as MATH 070 Essential Calculus 'or higher'; it is recorded as MATH 070 (4 Hour(s)); MATH 100 Calculus I, the higher option, is also 4 Hour(s). The catalog footnote allows another college-level statistics course to substitute for BIOL 205 with permission of the biology department chair. At least four of the eight biology courses must be taken at Salem.
